claims: WrestleMania 42 is scheduled for Saturday, April 18 and Sunday, April 19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 is at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada.
WrestleMania 42 is a two-night event.
WrestleMania 42 is returning to Las Vegas for the second consecutive year.
WrestleMania 42 is set to feature Roman Reigns, CM Punk, Cody Rhodes, and Rhea Ripley.
Tickets for WrestleMania 42 are on sale now via Ticketmaster.
There is an official trailer for the WrestleMania 42 event.
CM Punk vs. Roman Reigns is a confirmed or rumored World Heavyweight Championship match at WrestleMania 42.
Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton is a confirmed or rumored Undisputed WWE Championship match at WrestleMania 42.
Rhea Ripley vs. Jade Cargill is a confirmed or rumored WWE Women's Championship match at WrestleMania 42.
Liv Morgan vs. Stephanie Vaquer is a confirmed or rumored World Women's Championship match at WrestleMania 42.
Drew McIntyre vs. Jacob Fatu is a confirmed or rumored Unsanctioned Match at WrestleMania 42.
AJ Lee vs. Becky Lynch is a confirmed or rumored Women's Intercontinental Championship match at WrestleMania 42.
WWE will host Monday Night Raw in Las Vegas.
WWE will host Friday Night SmackDown in Las Vegas.
WWE will host Stand & Deliver in Las Vegas.
WWE will host WWE World in Las Vegas.
WrestleMania 42 will stream live on Peacock in the United States.
WrestleMania 42 will stream live on Netflix internationally.
Ticket packages for WrestleMania 42 are available through On Location.
